sourceSentences: If Skarner's attached target collides with terrain, the charge ends, detaching them from him, dealing physical damage, stunning them for 1.1 seconds, and reducing Ixtal's Impact's cooldown by 35%.
during which he gains slow immunity, becomes ghosted, ignores terrain collision, and has unobstructed vision of the surrounding 650 units.
Enemies cannot see Skarner while he is inside terrain, unless they grant sight into the area of terrain he is inside (such as with Hawkshot or Heightened Senses) or have unobstructed vision.
However, enemies will be notified when Skarner is inside nearby terrain while within a certain distance of him.
If the target resists the suppression through total crowd control immunity, displacement immunity, or a spell shield. Skarner will not attach them to himself, causing the charge to end instantly.

If the target removes the suppression by any means, including with an applicable cleanse effect or dispel, they will detach themselves from Skarner immediately which forces the charge to end instantly and not apply any damage.
Shattered Earth's duration is paused during Ixtal's Impact.
If Impale is cast during Shattered Earth, Skarner automatically casts Upheaval in the direction of Impale's cast.
Without incurring Upheaval's cast time
Skarner is unable to basic attack, cast Shattered Earth or Ixtal's Impact, or use during Impale.
While the targets are impaled, they are attached to Skarner 300 units in front of him.
If a target would be on the other side of a wall, they are moved to the same side as Skarner.

Skarner ends Shattered Earth by throwing his boulder in the target direction. It explodes upon colliding with the first enemy hit, applying the same damage and slow to the target and surrounding enemies as Shattered Earth's final empowered attack would.
Basic attacks that are dodged by the target or missed while Skarner is blinded do not apply stacks of Quake. Blocked attacks will still apply stacks.
Spell shield prevents Quaking's application from Upheaval and Impale only.
Note that if the main target is not blocking or dodging, then the area of effect can still deal damage to those who do.
